correspondence.explanation: All original data p,K,integer lam,V,x,y,h,v and arbitrary M remain parameters. H001/H002 are primality/characteristic, and H003 is the exact integer interval, including lam=0 and p=2. H004 retains finite dimension lam+1 and complex irreducibility as the generator-invariant-subspace dichotomy; under H005 these are exactly the original sl₂ highest-weight representation data. In H006 a free integer subgroup is its ℤ-submodule, with a paired basis and stability under every divided power; the Fin(ell+1) indexing is equivalent to an arbitrary paired basis under H003/H004 by its dimension and reindexing, in both directions. T002 establishes that the total restriction objects are the unique actual restrictions of x,y,h to M. T011 proves that TensorRight's K-action is on the K factor and its induced maps send m⊗a to f(m)⊗a; hence these are precisely the original prescribed operators, including characteristic 2. The conclusion asserts that this very M⊗ℤK is nonzero and that every K-linear subspace invariant under all three operators is zero or the whole space. Generator invariance is equivalent in both directions to invariance under their K-linear span, the prescribed L(K) action. There is no algebraic-closure hypothesis or exclusion of either boundary case.
